arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Nebraska argues the 1882 act diminished the reservation.
The Tribe argues the reservation status remains intact.
Justice Scalia questioned the reliance on de facto diminishment.
Justice Kagan questioned the weight of subsequent history.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether an 1882 congressional act diminished the Omaha Reservation. Nebraska argues the law redrew the boundaries. The Tribe argues the reservation status persists.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: Nebraska wants the Court to find the 1882 act diminished the reservation.
The Tribe wants the Court to find the reservation boundaries remain unchanged.

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Nebraska argues the 1882 act explicitly redrew the reservation boundaries.
The Tribe argues the reservation status persists until Congress explicitly changes it.
